summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'handleCreate is not defined' ReferenceError fix in LineItemsEditor.js. Logged in via PIN 112233, opened NEW SALE, clicked '+ Create new product…' (data-testid item-product-new-0). window.prompt appeared, accepted with 'QA New Product <ts>' — no page errors, no ReferenceError, no error overlay. Product auto-filled into line item, sale confirmed successfully (INV-1006, ₹1,180, profit ₹1,180). New product visible in Inventory Stock tab and in the product dropdown for subsequent sales. Regression: clicking an existing sale row opens the EDIT SALE dialog with prefilled product/customer/qty/rate — no errors.

issues: Select warning: changing from uncontrolled to controlled (item.product initial value)

critical_code_review_comments: LineItemsEditor Select: value={it.product || undefined} then setting to a string triggers uncontrolled->controlled warning; initialise product as '' and pass explicit value or use defaultValue consistently.
DialogContent should include DialogDescription or aria-describedby to satisfy Radix a11y warning.
seed_data_creation: Created one product 'QA New Product 1786639981' and one sale INV-1006 (QA Customer, qty 2 @ ₹500) during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed. Sidebar link text is 'Sales' (title case), not 'SALES'. window.prompt used for new product name — must register page.on('dialog', accept) BEFORE clicking item-product-new-0. sale-row-<id> testids are present and clickable.
rca of the issue: handleCreate function was referenced by the Select's onValueChange but was not defined in the LineItemsEditor component scope, causing ReferenceError when the '+ Create new product…' option (value='__new__') was chosen. Fix: re-added handleCreate(i) which prompts for name, calls onCreateProduct, and updates the line item. Verified: onValueChange now branches to handleCreate for '__new__' and selectProduct otherwise; no runtime errors captured via pageerror or console.
